The graph above shows $y=\operatorname{tan}⁡(Bx).$ What is the value of $B?$
question.worked_solution:
In order to find the value of $B,$ we first need to find the period of the function.

From the graph, we can see that function makes a complete cycles on the interval $(-\frac{\pi }{10},\frac{\pi }{10}).$ So, the period is $\frac{\pi }{5}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14254788/assets/37be228458a3e1959cf299aa20ab9a08c628b653589fa773af0971e80aa56588.png)

We know that for a function $y=\operatorname{tan}⁡(Bx),$ the horizontal scaling factor is $\frac{1}{B},$ and the period is multiplied by the scaling factor:

$$
\text{period}=\pi \cdot \frac{1}{B}
$$

For our particular function, the period is $\frac{\pi }{5},$ so we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\pi }{5} & =\pi \cdot \frac{1}{B} \\ \frac{1}{5} & =\frac{1}{B} \\ B & =5.\end{aligned}
$$
